data.raw_text:
Traffic Advisory 
Projects Commissioning in the FCT
Day 9 - Tuesday 24th June, 2025

In continuation of the ongoing commissioning of projects in the
FCT, there will be commissioning of the newly constructed right-hand service carriage way of the Inner Northern Expressway (INEX) from Ring Road 3 (RR 3) to Outer Northern Expressway (Murtala
Mohammed Expressway).

As such, Traffic will be slightly disrupted on the Jabi - Airport road, as its popularly called.

Furthermore, the Idu Railway Road will equally experience high traffic volume as dignitaries will be headed towards the venue of the event along INEX by bridge over railway lines.

Dei-Dei-Kubwa road could be another existing route after the commissioning.

Traffic control personnel and security agents will be deployed accordingly to ensure seamless traffic flows along the route.

- Head, Traffic (DRTS)
